messages.author: f8b7c6eae8e5aa1d
messages.subject: Execute JS in ShinyApp
parts:
Hi,

I'm struggling with a package that I updated, and now trying to get working with Shiny.

This packages produces a html string with a R-generated (from an SP object) slippy OpenLayers map.

I can't get it working with Shiny, having no error, but my javascript isn't executed.

To have a simple/reproducible example, I created a very tiny version of what I want to do, which can be seen here : https://github.com/RCura/webmaps/tree/master/test/shinyapp

You can also run it using this command  (require devtools to install the webmaps package) :
runGitHub(repo="webmaps", username="RCura", subdir="test/shinyapp/")

Now, my problem :

As you can see if you run the app, it doesn't show anything, there's an error at load time telling that init() (the js function) can't be found, and then, all remains blank.

To get it working, I got to run init() in my JS console.
And of course, the map doesn't get updated when I change the value of the slider, so, when calling init() multiple times, I get as many maps as I called init()

My guess, to get it working, would be, each time there's a call to output$webmap, to call those js functions :
document.getElementById('map').innerHTML = ""; init() ;

But I have no idea how to execute javascript in Shiny.

Any tips/clue on this issue ?

Thanks,

Robin
